programs.title: Castle In The Sky
programs.desc: This high-flying adventure begins when Pazu, an engineer's apprentice, spies a young girl, Sheeta, floating down from the sky, held aloft by a glowing pendant. Both Sheeta and Pazu are searching for the legendary floating castle, Laputa, and they vow to travel there together to unravel the mystery of the luminous crystal. But their quest won't be easy, as soon they are being pursued by greedy air pirates, the military and secret government agents, who all seek the power Sheeta alone can control.

programs.title: Delfin
programs.desc: Life isn't easy for Delfin, an 11-year-old boy who lives alone with his father in a small town outside of Buenos Aires. Delfin's ambition is to join a children's orchestra in a neighbouring village.

programs.title: The Talented Mr Ripley
programs.desc: Tom, a calculating young man, believes it's better to be a fake somebody than a real nobody. Opportunity knocks in the form of a wealthy US shipbuilder who hires Tom to travel to Italy to bring back his playboy son, Dickie. Ripley worms his way into the idyllic lives of Dickie and his girlfriend, plunging into a daring scheme of duplicity, lies and murder.

programs.title: Hounds
programs.desc: Living precariously on the margins of society, Hassan and his son Isaam earn money as lackeys for a local crime boss, who likes to fight dogs on the side. One night, when he loses his favourite dog in a fight, he sets Hassan and Isaam the task of kidnapping his rival’s right-hand man.

programs.title: The Movie Show
programs.desc: Pauline Collins joins Margaret Pomeranz to discuss her role in Shirley Valentine, exploring its character and story, followed by reviews of Blaze and Beyond the Valley of the Dolls.

programs.title: The Way Ahead
programs.desc: A lieutenant moulds a group of British civilians into a crack fighting unit to meet Rommel's forces in North Africa.
